answer: Allocate task slots through a uniform-price auction funded by escrowed coins; charge every winning slot and grant no free quota per account. Splitting one budget among clones cannot buy more slots at the clearing price. For a prism design, an oasis plan, or a canyon map, an attacker must fund each extra slot and loses its fee even if no useful work follows. Burn those fees so self-trading cannot refund them; account creation alone never increases purchasing power.
